name: pulse-reuse-decision
description: Decides whether to reuse, extend, refactor, or create a React component in this Laravel Inertia app. Use after auditing existing components and before introducing new abstractions or shared APIs.
purpose: Avoid speculative abstractions while still extracting reusable components when they reduce real complexity.
single_responsibility: Decide whether to reuse, extend, refactor, or create a component, justified by responsibility fit and blast radius rather than visual similarity.
triggers: A similar component or pattern may already exist
A new component might become shared
The requested change could fit an existing API
Refactoring may be safer than adding another component
completion_criteria: Reuse candidates are compared by responsibility, not appearance alone
Known and likely consumers are counted
Decision to reuse, extend, refactor, or create is explicit with rationale
Blast radius and tradeoffs are documented
Implementation path and follow-up skills are named
validation_criteria: Shared API work is routed to pulse-api-contract
failure_handling: If reuse versus create cannot be decided from audit findings and requirements, stop and report the missing information instead of guessing an abstraction.
Report the chosen decision with its tradeoffs and affected consumers.
escalation_path: Escalate scope, dependency, or product tradeoff decisions to the user.
Route shared or public API design to pulse-api-contract.
Route uncertain library capability to pulse-docs-research.
responsibilities: Decide whether to keep behaviour local.
Decide whether to extend, refactor, or create.
Reject reuse based only on visual similarity when behaviour, accessibility, or API responsibility differs.
